items.name: Berkeley Fall 2026

venue.name: Pauley Ballroom
venue.details: 3rd floor of the Martin Luther King Jr Student Union

items.information:
This competition is organized in partnership with [West Coast Cubing](https://www.westcoastcubing.com/) and [SpeedCubeShop](https://speedcubeshop.com/).

![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBZ0dKIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--60fae70c3e469b91d58257f4370c58af47b487da/scswcc5.png)

- [West Coast Cubing](https://www.westcoastcubing.com) presents another competition held in UC Berkeley!
- Gift cards to SpeedCubeShop will be provided to all 1st, 2nd, and 3rd place finishers in each event!
-  *If we run ahead of schedule, we will start first round events no earlier than 20 minutes, so please show up at least 20 minutes before your first event.*
- We will be assigning judging assignments to competitors for the group before or after their own competing groups. Please check your personal competitor cards when we assign them a week before the competition date for relevant info.

- Competitors and spectators under the age of 18 must be accompanied by a parent or guardian.
- Berkeley Cube Club and West Coast Cubing do not provide supervision and cannot assume responsibility for personal safety or belongings.

items.name: Hazlet Fall 2026
items.information:
This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the WCA regulations. If you are new to competing, please refer to the Competition Procedures tab.

Due to limited space, each competitor can bring **at most** 1 guest to the competition.

items.name: Minnesota Quiet Championship 2026
items.information:
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTg5ODQ5LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--9995391ee02575a28d82376a83e658f1162b7ec7/MN%20Quiet%20Champs%202026%20Logo.png)
### This is the 3rd annual Minnesota Championship! 

### This competition has no 3x3 and is not recommended for newcomers.

### Check out [Minnesota Championship 2026](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MinnesotaChampionship2026) for a typical competition experience!

This competition is supported by the [Midwest Cubing Association](https://www.midwestcubing.org/).
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBa2lJIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--1f97c854b41905e0a0658611c178db646a55f666/MCA-Final-Logo%20(WCA%20website%20version).png)

We have local Facebook groups for our Cubing Area. Feel free to join the [Minnesota Cubing Community](https://www.facebook.com/groups/1798123093777480) and follow the [Midwest Cubing Assocation ](https://www.facebook.com/midwestcubing)for information and announcements on upcoming competitions.

items.information:
**🇧🇷 Português (PT-BR)**
A competição é aberta a participantes de todas as idades. As inscrições devem ser feitas exclusivamente pelo site da WCA, com pagamento antecipado da taxa via PIX. A inscrição só será confirmada após a validação do pagamento.

Ao se inscrever, você autoriza a AACM, a WCA e seus parceiros a utilizar gratuitamente sua imagem em fotos e vídeos registrados durante o evento, inclusive para fins comerciais.

**🇺🇸 English (EN-US)**
The competition is open to participants of all ages. Registration must be completed exclusively through the WCA website, with advance payment of the fee via PIX (Brazilian instant payment system). Registration will only be confirmed after payment validation.

By registering, you authorize AACM, the WCA, and their partners to use your image free of charge in photos and videos recorded during the event, including for commercial purposes.
